roles.name: Knight
roles.blurb: Sworn to the sword. Doors open to steel and a hard stare.

roles.name: Scholar
roles.blurb: Letters, ledgers, and the patience to read a room.

roles.name: Merchant
roles.blurb: Coin is a language, and you are fluent.

roles.name: Outlaw
roles.blurb: Quick hands, quicker exits, no master but the night.

roles.name: Cleric
roles.blurb: The church's word carries where coin and steel cannot.

roles.name: Smith
roles.blurb: Honest craft and an arm like a trip-hammer.

backgrounds.name: Noble-born
backgrounds.blurb: A name that turns heads, and a purse to match.

backgrounds.name: Peasant
backgrounds.blurb: Raised on the land. Strong back, longer memory.

backgrounds.name: Foreigner
backgrounds.blurb: New to Hollowbrook, and you see what locals miss.

backgrounds.name: Orphan
backgrounds.blurb: Brought yourself up. Light-footed and hard to rattle.

backgrounds.name: Guild-raised
backgrounds.blurb: Apprenticed young; a trade and the gossip that comes with it.

backgrounds.name: Soldier's child
backgrounds.blurb: Camp-raised: handy, watchful, and used to marching orders.
